subject: Scheduling: SOC 2 + Pen Test walkthrough (split 60/30 US–EMEA overlap)
messages:
From: Amita Gupta <amita@finspire.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: sec-team@finspire.com
Date: Mon, 10 Jun 2029 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 + PenTest walkthrough — split session for US/EMEA overlap

Hi David,

Finspire's security team is ready to run a combined SOC 2 preflight and penetration test orientation with Redwood. We have a couple constraints: a) Ops leads in US prefer an early evening slot (ET) and b) EMEA engineering can join just after midnight UTC for a short focused Q&A.

Would Redwood be able to host a split 90-minute session: 60 minutes for the technical walkthrough (architecture, key controls, network/data flow), followed by a 30-minute separate pen-test scoping and logistics segment timed to overlap both regions for 15 minutes?

High-level ask:
- Goal: align on evidence sources, pen-test scope, DPA concerns, and bridge/runbook for the test
- Prefer week of Jun 17–21 (we're flexible)
- Attendees: Finspire Sec (me + infra lead), Redwood (solutions + security), plus pen vendor as needed

Attached is our latest evidence checklist — can you confirm if Redwood needs anything else upfront?

Thanks,
Amita Gupta
Security Lead | Finspire

Attachment: SOC2_preflight_checklist.pdf
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Amita Gupta <amita@finspire.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Jun 2029 17:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 + PenTest walkthrough — split session for US/EMEA overlap

Hi Amita — thanks for the note and the checklist, that's helpful. Happy to run the combined session. A few quick clarifications before we lock a slot:

1) Evidence transfer: we can accept a pre-upload to a shared Drive folder (read-only for vendor) or a secure SFTP transfer — whichever you prefer.
2) Bridge: we'll provide a dedicated ops bridge (redwood-ops-bridge.ics) and an ops engineer on the call for the whole 90 minutes.
3) Pen test scoping: for the 30-minute block, is the intention to do vendor onboarding + scope sign-off or just scoping?

Proposed windows (all times in ET):
- Option A: Jun 18, 17:00–18:30 ET (works well for our US team, EMEA joins 22:00 UTC for final 30)
- Option B: Jun 19, 18:30–20:00 ET (later; gives more overlap with EMEA)

I attached a short evidence manifest template (evidence_manifest_v2.xlsx) — if you can pre-populate that with file names and owners we can validate quickly during the call.

If either window works I will loop Camila and Olga to confirm internal availability and any compliance pre-reads.

Thanks,
David Kim
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: evidence_manifest_v2.xlsx, redwood-ops-bridge.ics
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>

Hi all — quick note from the compliance side: Jun 18 at 17:00 ET is okay for me but I want to flag two items to make the session productive:

• Evidence pre-read: please share the Drive folder link and populate the manifest at least 48 hours before the call. That lets us route any items that require legal review.
• DPA topics: if Finspire has a specific DPA clause set or questions, please add them to the Drive doc under "DPA: Qs" so we can bring legal on the follow-up rather than during the session.

Also, can we set the meeting length as 90 minutes with a hard stop and a separate follow-up invite for the pen vendor onboarding if they need more time? We don't want to bleed into other ops commitments.

Thanks — Camila
Camila Reyes
Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
